messages: Not sure what you're lookin' for...
Long as the grounds needs keepin', I won't be out a job.

suite.message: Just makin' sure the soil is nice and soft, and keepin' an eye on things around the village.
Gives me somethin' to take my mind off the raids.
Yeah, a surveyor came through here not too long ago. Said he was lookin' for Young Mimic.
Told him he was two weeks too late. Young Mimic got killed by Sergeant Haunch and his big ol' laser gun.
I do miss that boy, lemme tell ya. We used to drink each other under the table over at the Chafed Worm.

messages: Nothing like a cold drink after a long day of hard workin'
Best be stayin' away from the wild woods. Nothing but trouble out there.

suite.message: Indeed I do. Ever since Sergeant Haunch destroyed my house in Upper Woodshine, Garth here has been puttin' me up in a spare bed.
But they say don't sleep where you drink...
There's been more critters wandering in the woods lately.
Some say it's because the Mother Worm is gonna wake up soon, but I got my doubts.
Either way, makes me all the more content to keep my rear end right where it is.
